name: Wife
source:
The protagonist's unnamed wife. She's away on business so she leaves her husband to watch over them. Although she's absent she calls from time to time to check on her daughters. She worries about the eroge he plays.

She reminds the protagonist not to do anything to them, they are after all, his daughters ...
